citations.title: Refund approvals
citations.quote:
Refunds over £500 require approval by the **Ops Manager** before payment is released.
Standard refunds under £500 are processed by any support agent within 48 hours.
Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method only.

citations.title: Org chart
citations.quote:
**Founder:** Alex Doyle. Sets pricing, signs anything customer-facing.
**Ops Manager:** Sarah Chen. Owns day-to-day operations, budgets and sign-offs.
**Support Lead:** Priya Patel. Runs the support rota and handles escalations.

citations.title: Supplier payments
citations.quote:
Supplier invoices are paid on 30-day terms.
Any payment over £2,000 requires **Founder** sign-off before it is scheduled.
New suppliers must be added to the tooling inventory before their first invoice.

citations.title: Delegation memo
citations.quote:
Sarah Chen is on leave from 1 to 31 March.
During this period all of her sign-offs and approvals are delegated to **Marcus Webb**.
Marcus has full authority on operational decisions while the cover is in place.

citations.title: Customer support SOP
citations.quote:
Support agents answer tickets within one business day.
Refunds under £500 are processed directly by the agent, per the refund approvals policy.
Complaints and anything unresolved after two replies escalate to the **Support Lead**.

citations.title: Onboarding process
citations.quote:
New starters are onboarded over their first week, owned by the **Ops Manager**.
Day one covers accounts and access, using the tooling inventory as the checklist.
Week one ends with a shadowing shift alongside the support team.
